A Thank you to Script writers

Just would like to let the scriptures know that I appreciate seeing all the wonderful scripts.
I am not one to take advantage of people and although I've downloaded and 
tested a few scripts I have as yet to actually use any for a finished project . . .
thus I have not purchased or donated to any yet.

I run into problems when I try to animate the particular items I have scripts added to:  
With the hair script my computer freezes up when I put enough particles of fur on an objet to cover all patches of skin on the animal.
With the loft script for the sails.  I can't animate the sails using the wind effector.

If and when I do use a script for a final project I will be very happy to purchase or donate to the cause.

It's hard to communicate via computer without misunderstanding happening now and then.  I am most certainly not perfect.  
I do, however respect and appreciate everyone on the forum.  
If ever I sound offensive please let me know so I can set things right.

My Best Regards
Jeanny
